registered: 2026-11-17 ~16:40 ET, before any news history was fetched or any result read
operator: 11/17: 'start building the news source test' - more opens with the strategy intact (entry rule and exits unchanged)
question: Do names with fresh Alpaca news, admitted by the desk's own rule, add buy signals the desk does not already get - at no worse quality?

data.news: Alpaca historical news (free with the account, data-only keys), 07:00-15:30 ET per day, cached in ai_reports/news_source/news/<day>.json
data.bars: SIP minute-bar warehouse ai_reports/warehouse/sip (+ SPY/QQQ via sip_hedge). A news name with no bars there is counted, not scored.
data.seen: names the desk already had that day = every symbol in that day's admission ledger (ai_reports/admit_ledger/<day>.jsonl, or ~/data_archive/admit_ledger/<day>.jsonl.gz)

rule.causal: a news name is a candidate only from the minute of its FIRST story that day (stories before 09:30 count at 09:30). Nothing after a signal minute is used to admit it.
rule.admission: the desk's rule at the signal minute: price $20-$400, day change >= 1.5% vs prior close (the RELATIVE variant with the live market_tape bar is an information cell)
rule.signal: the desk's live pre-square arm (evening_family.presquare_bars, fast %R 21), refractory 30 min, minutes 15-360
rule.trade: buy open t+1, sell close t+10, cost 6 bp (10 bp stress) - the same as tools/studies/relative_admit.py

arms.BASE: signals on the tight-screener universe (top 400 liquid, ETFs out) admitted by the same rule - the supply the desk already has
arms.NEWS_EXTRA: signals on news candidates that are NOT in that day's admission ledger and NOT in the top-400 universe

turn_on_if_ALL (ledger days only).more_opens: NEWS_EXTRA signals per 10 min >= 15% of BASE signals per 10 min
turn_on_if_ALL (ledger days only).quality_net: NEWS_EXTRA mean net bp >= BASE mean net bp - 1.0, AND day-clustered t of (extra - base) > -2.0
turn_on_if_ALL (ledger days only).enough_data: >= 30 ledger days with bars and >= 300 NEWS_EXTRA signals; if fewer, the verdict is UNDERPOWERED (not a pass)

information_cells: all warehouse days, extra = not in top-400 (no ledger)
share of news names with no bars
else: do not build the live source; report which condition failed
after_pass: build the news source behind a switch (default off); it becomes the NEXT week's single live experiment after market-relative admission is judged
caveats: signals are an upper bound on opens (spread/volume/tape gates not modelled, equal for both arms); minute bars, not the live tick path; news symbols tag related companies too, so some candidates are mentions, not the subject
